reasons: Same quantity: postgresql.tup_returned is the monotonic counter behind Datadog postgresql.rows_returned, and rate() yields per-second rows, matching the '(per sec)' widget.
Unit is compatible: the rate is rows per second in both.
Aggregation and grouping match: avg with no by-clause mirrors the Datadog avg over all series in scope.
Template variable $scope has no tag prefix and default *, so dropping it is correct.

Series grain caveat: OTel series are split per database, table, operation and source (observed labels postgresql_database_name and postgresql_table_name), so avg over them may differ from Datadog's per-database series. Averaging across table-level series would need a database-level collapse, e.g. sum by (postgresql_database_name) before avg, to match the Datadog grain.
Outcome translated is correct since an exact-enough mapping exists.
